task.description: The task to execute; mindmap-creator only serves mindmap.

roomId.description: Target room id injected by the gateway; binds provenance to the room.

scope.description: document = one document's full markdown; room = concatenated titled documents of the room.

title.description: Map root context: document title or room title.

roomSummary.description: Room summary/overview text, room scope only, context framing.

content.description: Source material assembled by the gateway. document scope = full markdown of one document; room scope = concatenated titled documents.

contentTruncated.description: True when the gateway truncated the assembled material to fit the budget.

responseLanguage.description: Preferred label language hint (e.g. a BCP-47 tag); fall back to the material's own language.
